mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.0% signals aggressive monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points triggers reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a collapsing housing market that reduces consumer wealth and credit availability, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 100 signals reduced manufacturing output and capacity utilization, lowering corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase exceeding 4.0% triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and reducing valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining GDP growth (GDPC1) below 0.5% annually signals reduced consumer demand and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signal a broad-based economic contraction that reduces corporate output and revenue, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.
